projects.title: EyeNexus: Adaptive Gaze-Driven Quality and Bitrate Streaming for Seamless VR Cloud Gaming Experiences
projects.description: Implement foveated rendering and encoding with adaptive bitrate for VR Cloud Gaming. Accepted by CoNext 2025.

projects.title: PyraMotion: Attentional Pyramid-Structured Motion Integration for Co-Speech 3D Gesture Synthesis
projects.description: Generating full-body human gestures encompassing face, body, hands, and global movements from audio for virtual avatar creation. Accepted by NeurIPS 2025.

projects.title: FovOptix: Human Vision-Compatible Video Encoding and Adaptive Streaming in VR Cloud Gaming
projects.description: Implement Fixed-Foveated Video Encoder to enhance the smoothness and user experience of VR Cloud Gaming. Accepted by MMSYS 2024.
